PREPHUB.Settings.ServerUrl.Name: Prep Hub URL
PREPHUB.Settings.ServerUrl.Hint: Where Prep Hub is running, usually http://localhost:4100. Prep Hub must run on the same computer as this browser (or be reachable from it).
PREPHUB.Settings.BridgeKey.Name: Bridge key
PREPHUB.Settings.BridgeKey.Hint: Copy this from the Foundry page in Prep Hub. It stops other websites from talking to your Prep Hub.
PREPHUB.Settings.AutoConnect.Name: Connect automatically
PREPHUB.Settings.AutoConnect.Hint: Connect to Prep Hub when you log in as GM.
PREPHUB.Settings.AutoSyncParty.Name: Send party on connect
PREPHUB.Settings.AutoSyncParty.Hint: Send player characters (name, level, class…) to Prep Hub each time you connect.
PREPHUB.Menu.Name: Prep Hub
PREPHUB.Menu.Label: Open Prep Hub panel
PREPHUB.Menu.Hint: Connection status, bestiary and party sync.
